login.title: Sign in with mod.io
login.heading: Connect your mod.io account
login.steps:
1.  Open the Access page of your mod.io account (button below).
2.  Generate a "personal access token" named "Karl":
       Permissions: tick only User actions
       Scope: Read and Write
       Expiry: the longest duration
3.  Copy the token and paste it here. Karl only stores it on your PC.

integ.ask:
{n} active mods with blueprints (e.g. Mod Hub, HUDs) need Karl's integration to run.

Karl installs UE4SS (open source framework, github.com/UE4SS-RE/RE-UE4SS) in the game's Binaries\Win64 folder and adds its KarlLoader script, which starts the mods in the Space Rig and on missions. If another mod loader is there, its files are moved to a backup (not deleted).

Install now? (with the game closed)
integ.missing: {n} mods with blueprints won't start: Karl's integration is missing.
integ.done: Integration installed: {n} mods with blueprints will be started by Karl.
official.found:
The game still sees {n} mods, so it flags you as modded and the menu doesn't show 0 mods:
{mods}

Karl brings them to zero: it removes the subscriptions on mod.io and moves the FSD\Mods folders to FSD\_karl_backup_mods (nothing is deleted). All these mods stay in Karl and Karl installs them.

If you build your own mod into FSD\Mods, from now on build it into another folder and add it with "Add .pak file…".

Proceed?

integ.proton_first_run:
On Linux DRG runs through Proton: to start blueprint mods Karl has to configure the game's Proton prefix, which Steam creates on first launch.

Start DRG once from Steam, close it and press 💾 Install and save: Karl will do the rest.
